Well "Aes Sedai" translates as Servant of All in the old tongue.  My moniker implies a 2nd Age understanding of the term - and should seperate itself from the Aes Sedai of the 3rd age.  It also means I am serving everyone on the net who cares about WoT and wants to learn about it.  So - no.  I won't write Aes Sedai.  I am a Servant of All.
